text: As per Items 1 and 2, letters were sent to NSW Minister for Climate Change, for Energy and for the Environment, the Minister for Planning and Public Spaces, and the Minister for Crown Lands on 7 September. As per Item 3 the Ministerial correspondence reflects that Lane Cove Council is a member of Resilient Sydney, and Council's General Manager is a member of the Resilient Sydney Steering Committee and serves as its Waste Lead. Council is therefore well placed to contribute to and support a coordinated Greater Sydney response to this critical issue. Accordingly, Council supports coordinated advocacy on strategic waste planning through Resilient Sydney and the metropolitan Regional Organisations of Councils (ROCs) and encourages the NSW Government to work closely with these organisations in developing long-term solutions.
